pub type Raw
pub enum ObservationOutcome
  Pending
  Answered
  Unknown
  Gone
  Invalid
  Conflict
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 8]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum OperatorPageOutcome
  Page
  Gap
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 5]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum OperatorDecisionOutcome
  Answered
  Conflict
  Unknown
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 6]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum OperatorRetirementOutcome
  Retired
  Unknown
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 5]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub mod service_error_code
  pub const HANDLER_ERROR: &str
  pub const INVALID_RESULT: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_VERSION: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_SERVICE: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_METHOD: &str
  pub const WRONG_MODE: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 6]
pub const OPERATIONS: [&str; 5]
pub const REFUSAL_CODES: [&str; 11]
pub const RESOURCE_ACTIONS: [&str; 1]
pub struct Question
  asker: String
  key: String
  slots: BTreeMap<String, String>
pub struct Request
  op: String
  ask: Option<Question>
  wait: bool
  id: String
  option: String
  admin: String
pub struct Answer
  id: String
  pending: bool
  option: String
  yes: bool
  kept: bool
pub struct RecordMetadata
  id: String
  asker: String
  key: String
  about: String
  text: String
  options: Vec<String>
  asked: String
  option: String
  answered: String
  kept: bool
  yes: bool
pub struct ResponseMetadata
  code: String
  error: String
  answer: Option<Answer>
  records: Vec<RecordMetadata>
pub struct ApplicationQuestion
  request_key: String
  key: String
  slots: BTreeMap<String, String>
pub struct QuestionObservation
  outcome: ObservationOutcome
  answer: Option<Answer>
pub struct OperatorPage
  outcome: OperatorPageOutcome
  records: Vec<RecordMetadata>
  next: String
  complete: bool
pub struct OperatorDecision
  outcome: OperatorDecisionOutcome
  record: Option<RecordMetadata>
pub struct OperatorRetirement
  outcome: OperatorRetirementOutcome
  record: Option<RecordMetadata>
pub fn encode(v: &Request) -> Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Request, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: String
  message: String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait QuestionApplication
  type Error
  fn ask(&self, question: ApplicationQuestion) -> Result<QuestionObservation, Self::Error>
  fn observe(&self, request_key: String, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<QuestionObservation, Self::Error>
pub struct QuestionApplicationClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait QuestionOperator
  type Error
  fn list_questions(&self, cursor: String, limit: i64) -> Result<OperatorPage, Self::Error>
  fn answer_question(&self, id: String, option: String) -> Result<OperatorDecision, Self::Error>
  fn retire_question(&self, id: String) -> Result<OperatorRetirement, Self::Error>
pub struct QuestionOperatorClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
